{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gricul Salvage Yards''' was a famous chop-shop and repair yards, located in [[Meirm City]] on [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. It was owned by [[Xizor Transport Systems/Legends|Xizor Transport Systems]].
